content.short: Layer3 is the consumer attention layer of Web3, connecting users with blockchain apps through quests, rewards, and the $L3 token across every chain.
content.description: Layer3 is a decentralized user acquisition and engagement protocol that enables Web3 projects to distribute rewards and onboard users through structured quest campaigns powered by the $L3 token. The platform acts as the attention layer of the decentralized web connecting protocols with targeted audiences 24/7 across all supported chains. Layer3 has facilitated millions of on-chain interactions across hundreds of protocols, making it a leading growth tool for Mantle ecosystem projects.
content.meta: Layer3 is the Web3 consumer attention layer connecting users with quests and rewards on Mantle and beyond.
